title: Complete audit
purpose: Record what was physically observed at every position and freeze the comparison results.

sections.title: Access and prerequisites
paragraphs: Administrators, repository managers and technicians create, complete and cancel audits. Viewers read audits and their results. Accounts without an application role, including superuser accounts without a role, have no access.

The audit must still be open and its storage snapshot current. A finalized or stale audit opens with a Not available notice, disabled fields and no submit button. Cancel returns to the audit record. Storage is rechecked under lock when submitting.

If storage changes or another operator finalizes the audit before your submission, the rejected values remain visible in disabled controls for review. They are not saved as a draft, and the blocked form cannot be submitted again.

items.label: Box, Snapshot location and Snapshot time
items.description: Read-only identity, frozen full location and server time in repository time. Expected accession and Blocked at snapshot are context, never automatic observation input.

items.label: Observed contents
items.description: Required for every position. Starts at Not yet observed; choose Empty explicitly or choose Accession. Leaving a position unobserved is rejected, even where inventory expects empty.

items.label: Observed accession
items.description: Required when Accession is selected, at most 80 characters after trimming surrounding spaces. Enter the exact accession you observed, including an unknown barcode when necessary. Clear the accession when selecting Empty. The same observed accession cannot appear twice in the audit, ignoring letter case.

items.label: Completion reason
items.description: Required, up to 4,000 characters. Retained with the completing actor and server-recorded time. Do not enter identifying information.

items.label: Discrepancy explanation
items.description: Up to 4,000 characters, required if any position differs. Describe missing, unexpected or different contents. Empty positions that agree count as matches. Unknown accessions are retained as discrepancies.

sections.title: Complete audit and Cancel
paragraphs: Complete audit validates every position and saves all results in one transaction with its audit event. Match, missing, unexpected and mismatch counts are computed from the frozen expectations and submitted observations. It opens the immutable completed record. These are working product defaults, not repository policy. Audits record evidence only. They never change storage positions, specimen records, quantities, statuses or holds. A discrepancy needs follow-up through the ordinary inventory workflows; it is not a correction.

Observations are not saved as a draft. Cancel or leaving the form discards unsaved entries. Validation errors keep submitted values on this form; a storage change prevents saving and requires cancel/re-audit rather than retrying the old snapshot.

Any recorded movement involving this box since creation invalidates completion, even move-out-and-back or backdated movements. Moving an empty box or its ancestor also invalidates it, as do position block changes or retirement/inactive ancestry. Unrelated movement is ignored. Ordinary storage operations are never frozen by an audit.
Completed results cannot be edited. Use New audit of this box from the record to retain a linked follow-up; cancel a stale open audit first.
